# FlexibleManifoldReconfiguration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability of a neural network to rapidly alter its manifold structure in response to changing task demands or environmental perturbations. Key for achieving versatility in neuromorphic controllers without retraining, enabling multi-task and adaptive closed-loop operation.
